newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA JAN-JULY TRADE SURPLUS $20.53 BLN-CUSTOMS.
newsitem.headline: CHINA JAN-JULY TRADE SURPLUS $20.53 BLN-CUSTOMS.

text.p: China's trade surplus widened to $20.53 billion in January-July compared with $1.965 billion in the year-ago period, customs figures showed on Thursday.
In July alone, imports totalled $12.82 billion, up 13.4 percent from a year ago and up 13.8 percent compared with the previous month, the customs said.
The customs gave no figure for exports in July.
General and processed trade both increased in July, it said without giving details.
In July, exports by state enterprises increased, it said without elaborating.
Exports by state enterprises in January-July totalled $54.49 billion, it said without giving comparative figures.
For the first seven months, the growth of exports by state enterprises was faster than that of exports by foreign-funded firms, it said.
Exports of machinery and electronic goods totalled $30.56 billion in the first seven months while imports were $29.95 billion, it said.
Exports of garments, shoes and toys all surged while imports of machinery, transportation equipment and steel products fell, it said.
